title: Darius Slayton could be out with the Giants

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Darius Slayton could be out with the Giants
sources.description: With so much focus on whether former Giants star receiver Odell Beckham Jr. will make the team in his first year back on the roster since 2018, a receiver drafted a month after OBJ would traded is in danger of not surviving Sunday's cuts.
